entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have inflation
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin nema inflaciju

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Inflacija znači da vaš novac s vremenom kupuje sve manje. Bitcoin je bolji novac jer nema inflaciju.

entries.englishValue: Dollars have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Povijesno gledano, Bitcoin je s vremenom povećavao kupovnu moć, dok je Australski dolar svoju gubio. Mnogi ljudi koriste Bitcoin kao dugoročni štedni račun — novac koji ostaje netaknut godinama dok mu vrijednost raste.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Što biste radije: štedjeli u australskim dolarima — australskih dolara koji s vremenom kupuju sve manje — ili štedjeli u Bitcoinu koji povijesno kupuje sve više?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je također alat slobode

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin mreža nije ničije vlasništvo. Niti ju jedna vlada niti ijedna tvrtka ne kontrolira. Izgrađena je da štiti vašu slobodu i vaš novac.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Ljudi širom svijeta upravo sada koriste Bitcoin za zaštitu svoje slobode — čak i kad im vlade ne žele pomoći ili ih pokušavaju zaustaviti.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Australian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Ako štedite u australskim dolarima, vjerojatno ste primijetili da vaš novac kupuje sve manje. Trebate više australskih dolara da kupite iste stvari. Trebate više australskih dolara da održite isti životni standard.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Ali ne mora tako biti.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: Život je postao jeftiniji za ljude koji su posljednje 4 godine štedjeli u Bitcoinu.

entries.englishValue: Here's the proof: your money is losing value
entries.targetTranslation: Evo dokaza: vaš novac gubi vrijednost

entries.englishValue: The dollars in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many dollars can be created.

entries.targetTranslation: Ova neograničena ponuda glavni je uzrok inflacije. Posljednjih godina količina australskih dolara u optjecaju dramatično je porasla.

entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ima strogi limit od 21 milijun kovanica koji će ikada postojati, čineći ga najoskudnijom digitalnom imovinom. Većina kripto projekata ima neograničenu ponudu, inflacijske mehanizme ili može tiskati nove tokene po želji, razrjeđujući vrijednost vlasnika tijekom vremena.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ima fiksno ograničenje od 21 milijuna — najrjeđa digitalna imovina. Većina kripto projekata ima neograničenu ponudu ili mehanizme za stvaranje novih tokena prema volji, što razrjeđuje vlasnike.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has one simple purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it with basic knowledge. Many crypto projects involve complex smart contracts, DeFi protocols, or governance mechanisms that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has one purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it. Most crypto involves complex smart contracts or DeFi that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ima jednu jednostavnu svrhu: peer-to-peer digitalni novac. Svatko ga može razumjeti i koristiti s osnovnim znanjem. Mnogi kripto projekti uključuju složene pametne ugovore, DeFi protokole ili mehanizme upravljanja koji zahtijevaju tehničku stručnost za sigurno korištenje.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ima jednu svrhu: peer-to-peer digitalni novac. Svi ga razumiju, svi ga mogu koristiti. Većina kripto projekata uključuje složene pametne ugovore ili DeFi koji zahtijevaju stručno tehničko znanje za sigurno korištenje.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin uses Proof of Work consensus, which has been battle-tested for over 15 years without a single successful attack on the main network. entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's Proof of Work has run without a successful attack on the main network for over 15 years. Most crypto projects use experimental consensus that hasn't been battle-tested.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin koristi Proof of Work konsenzus koji je testiran u borbi više od 15 godina bez jednog uspješnog napada na glavnu mrežu. entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is digital money — a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are speculative utility or governance tokens with unclear real-world value.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin služi kao digitalni novac - sredstvo očuvanja vrijednosti i sredstvo razmjene. Većina kripto tokena su utility tokeni za specifične platforme, tokeni za upravljanje ili špekulativna imovina s nejasnim prijedlozima stvarne vrijednosti.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je digitalni novac — pohrana vrijednosti i sredstvo razmjene. Većina kripto tokena su špekulativni, uslužni ili upravljački tokeni bez jasne stvarne vrijednosti.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin becomes stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism thrown at it. Most crypto projects are fragile and can collapse from regulatory pressure, technical failures, or market downturns.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin grows stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism. Most crypto projects collapse under regulatory, technical, or market pressure.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin postaje jači pod napadom i preživio je svaku krizu, zabranu i kritiku. Većina kripto projekata je krhka i može propasti pod regulatornim pritiskom, tehničkim kvarovima ili tržišnim padovima.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je čvrsto stajao pred napadima i preživio svaku krizu, zabranu i kritiku. Većina kripto projekata propada pod regulatornim, tehničkim ili tržišnim pritiskom.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company behind it, and no single point of failure. Many crypto projects are backed by venture capital firms, have identifiable leadership teams, or depend on specific companies for their continued operation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company, no single point of failure. Most crypto projects depend on VCs, specific leadership, or one company's survival.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin nema izvršnog direktora, tvrtku iza sebe ni jednu točku kvara. Mnogi kripto projekti podržani su od strane fondova rizičnog kapitala, imaju prepoznatljive upravljačke timove ili ovise o specifičnim tvrtkama za svoj nastavak rada.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin nema CEO-a, tvrtku ni jednu točku kvara. Većina kripto projekata ovisi o investitorima rizičnog kapitala, identificiranim vodećim timovima ili o postojanju jedne tvrtke.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is perfectly fungible, meaning every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Fine art is non-fungible by nature, with each piece being unique in its creation, history, condition, and provenance, making direct comparisons and valuations extremely difficult.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every artwork is unique — different creation, history, condition, and provenance make direct comparisons extremely difficult.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je savršeno zamjenjiv, što znači da je svaki bitcoin identičan i zamjenjiv - jedan bitcoin jednak je jednom bitcoinu bilo gdje u svijetu. Umjetnine su po prirodi nezamjenjive, svako djelo jedinstveno je po svojoj kreaciji, povijesti, stanju i porijeklu, što čini izravne usporedbe i vrednovanja iznimno teškima.
entries.targetTranslation: Svaki Bitcoin je jednak i zamjenjiv. Svako umjetničko djelo je jedinstveno — porijeklo, povijest, stanje i autentičnost variraju, što izravnu usporedbu čini vrlo teškom.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades on a global 24/7 market where anyone with internet access can buy or sell instantly. Fine art requires specialized auction houses like Sotheby's or Christie's, private dealers, or exclusive galleries. Sales can take months to arrange and complete, with limited market access and irregular trading opportunities.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 on a global market accessible to anyone. Fine art requires specialized auction houses, private dealers, or galleries and can take months to sell.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se trguje na globalnom tržištu 24/7 gdje bilo tko s pristupom internetu može kupiti ili prodati trenutačno. Umjetnine zahtijevaju specijalizirane aukcijske kuće poput Sotheby's ili Christie's, privatne trgovce ili ekskluzivne galerije. Prodaja može trajati mjesecima za organiziranje i dovršavanje, s ograničenim pristupom tržištu i nepravilnim prilikama za trgovanje.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se prodaje na globalnom tržištu 24/7 i dostupan je svima. Umjetnost zahtijeva aukcijske kuće, privatne trgovce ili specijalizirane galerije, a prodaja može trajati mjesecima.

entries.englishValueBefore: Buying or selling bitcoin typically costs less than 1% in fees, often much less. Fine art sales involve substantial costs including buyer's premiums (10-25%), seller's commissions (10-15%), insurance, transportation, storage, and authentication fees. These combined costs can easily exceed 30-40% of the artwork's value in a single transaction.
entries.englishValue: Buying or selling Bitcoin costs under 1% in fees, often much less. Art sales rack up 30–40% in buyer's premiums, commissions, insurance, transport, and authentication fees.
entries.currentValue: Kupnja ili prodaja bitcoina obično košta manje od 1% u naknadama, često i mnogo manje. entries.targetTranslation: Kupnja ili prodaja Bitcoina košta manje od 1 % naknada, često znatno manje. Prodaja umjetnina nagomilava 30 – 40 % naknada za kupce kroz aukcijske provizije, osiguranje, prijevoz i troškove autentifikacije.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size from microtransactions to large purchases. Fine art cannot be divided - you cannot own a fraction of a painting or sell just part of a sculpture. This indivisibility limits investment flexibility and liquidity options.

entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se može podijeliti na 100 milijuna manjih jedinica zvanih satoshi, čineći ga savršenim za transakcije bilo koje veličine od mikrotransakcija do velikih kupnji. entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se može podijeliti na 100 milijuna satoshija i izvrstan je za transakcije bilo koje veličine. Ne možete posjedovati dio slike ili ugao skulpture bez rizika druge ugovorne strane.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified on the blockchain by anyone with basic technical knowledge. Fine art requires expensive expert authentication, provenance research, and scientific analysis. Even with expert verification, forgeries regularly fool the art world, and authentication disputes can destroy an artwork's value overnight. Bitcoin, on the other hand, cannot be forged or counterfeited.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified by anyone on-chain. Art authentication is expensive, slow, and still routinely fooled by forgers — destroying an artwork's value overnight.
entries.currentValue: Vlasništvo i autentičnost Bitcoina mogu se kriptografski provjeriti na blockchainu od strane bilo koga s osnovnim tehničkim znanjem. Umjetnine zahtijevaju skupu stručnu autentifikaciju, istraživanje porijekla i znanstvenu analizu. Čak i uz stručnu verifikaciju, krivotvorine redovito obmanjuju svijet umjetnosti, a sporovi o autentifikaciji mogu uništiti vrijednost umjetnine preko noći. Bitcoin se, s druge strane, ne može krivotvoriti ili lažirati.
entries.targetTranslation: Vlasništvo i autentičnost Bitcoina svatko može kriptografski provjeriti na blockchainu. Provjera autentičnosti umjetnine skupa je i spora, a krivotvoritelji redovito varaju tržište — vrijednost umjetnine može preko noći nestati.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, theft, or other disasters. Fine art is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and deterioration. Even with expensive climate-controlled storage and comprehensive insurance, artworks can be damaged by environmental factors, accidents, or natural disasters, potentially losing all value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives floods, fires, earthquakes, and theft. Fine art is vulnerable to every form of physical destruction, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin, kada je pravilno sigurnosno kopiran, ne može biti uništen poplavama, požarima, potresima, uraganima, krađom ili drugim katastrofama. Umjetnine su ranjive na sve oblike fizičkog uništenja i propadanja. Čak i uz skupu klimatski kontroliranu pohranu i sveobuhvatno osiguranje, umjetnička djela mogu biti oštećena okolišnim čimbenicima, nesrećama ili prirodnim katastrofama, potencijalno gubeći svu vrijednost.
entries.targetTranslation: Dobro pohranjen Bitcoin preživljava poplave, požare, potrese i krađu. Umjetnost je ranjiva na svaku fizičku katastrofu, a osiguranje rijetko sve pokriva.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold by anyone with internet access and a small amount of money to invest. Fine art investment is largely limited to wealthy collectors due to high minimum prices, exclusive auction access, storage requirements, insurance costs, and the specialized knowledge needed to navigate the art market successfully.
entries.englishValue: Anyone with an internet connection and a little money can buy Bitcoin. Fine art investment is effectively limited to wealthy collectors with auction access and specialized knowledge.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin može kupiti i prodati bilo tko s pristupom internetu i malom količinom novca za ulaganje. Ulaganje u umjetnine uglavnom je ograničeno na bogate kolekcionare zbog visokih minimalnih cijena, ekskluzivnog pristupa aukcijama, zahtjeva za pohranu, troškova osiguranja i specijaliziranog znanja potrebnog za uspješno snalaženje na tržištu umjetnina.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin može kupiti svatko s internetskom vezom i nešto novca. Ulaganje u umjetnost u praksi je ograničeno na bogate kolekcionare s pristupom aukcijama i stručnim znanjem.

entries.englishValueBefore: Because Bitcoin is digital, it can be sent almost instantly for very low fees by anyone with an Internet connection. Because Gold is physical, it cannot be moved across the Internet and must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can be sent instantly over the internet for low fees. Gold must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.currentValue: Budući da je Bitcoin digitalan, može ga gotovo trenutačno poslati bilo tko s internetskom vezom uz vrlo niske naknade. Budući da je zlato fizičko, ne može se premještati putem interneta i mora se fizički isporučiti za prijenos vlasništva.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se može poslati trenutačno preko interneta uz niske naknade. Zlato se mora fizički prevoziti da bi promijenilo vlasnika.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset, which means you can transfer full ownership of it over the Internet. Some companies offer the ability to buy gold online without receiving the actual physical gold, instead trusting the company to hold the gold for you. This is more like a Digital IOU since you only own a promise from the company instead of the actual asset.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset you can transfer over the internet. Online gold is a Digital IOU — you only own a promise from a custodian, not the metal itself.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je digitalno izvorna imovina, što znači da možete prenijeti potpuno vlasništvo nad njim putem interneta. Neke tvrtke nude mogućnost kupnje zlata online bez primanja stvarnog fizičkog zlata, umjesto toga vjerujete tvrtki da čuva zlato za vas. To je više poput digitalne potvrde o dugu jer posjedujete samo obećanje tvrtke umjesto stvarne imovine.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je inherentno digitalna imovina koju možete prenositi preko interneta. Zlato na internetu samo je digitalna obveznica — imate samo skrbnikovo obećanje, ne i metal.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 Million BTC that will ever exist.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million BTC. Gold's supply grows about 1.6% per year, shrinking your slice — less than fiat
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ima strogi limit od 21 milijun BTC-a koji će ikada postojati.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ima fiksno ograničenje od 21 milijuna BTC-a. Ponuda zlata raste oko 1,6 % godišnje i smanjuje vaš dio kolača — manje od fiat

entries.englishValueBefore: New gold supply is pulled out of the ground each year, resulting in inflation of the total supply. It's estimated that the total supply of gold increases by about 1.6% per year, which means your slice of the pie shrinks by 1.6% per year.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Nova ponuda zlata vadi se iz tla svake godine, što rezultira inflacijom ukupne ponude. Procjenjuje se da se ukupna ponuda zlata povećava za oko 1,6% godišnje, što znači da se vaš dio kolača smanjuje za 1,6% godišnje.
entries.targetTranslation: inflacije

entries.englishValueBefore: This is less than fiat inflation, but still inflation.
entries.englishValue: — but still inflation.
entries.currentValue: To je manje od fiat inflacije, ali je još uvijek inflacija.
entries.targetTranslation: , ali još uvijek inflacija.

entries.englishValueBefore: Gold has an elastic supply, meaning that as the price of gold rises, there is a greater incentive to mine more gold. This often puts downward pressure on the gold price as new mines come online.
entries.englishValue: When gold prices rise, more gold gets mined, pushing the price back down. Bitcoin's supply is inelastic — no matter how high the price goes, there will only ever be 21 million.
entries.currentValue: Zlato ima elastičnu ponudu, što znači da kako cijena zlata raste, postoji veći poticaj za rudarenje više zlata. To često vrši pritisak na pad cijene zlata dok se novi rudnici otvaraju.
entries.targetTranslation: Kad cijena zlata raste, više se zlata vadi iz rude i cijena ponovno pada. Ponuda Bitcoina je neelastična — bez obzira koliko cijena raste, uvijek će ih biti samo 21 milijun.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Tens of thousands of independent nodes validate the Bitcoin network. Most physical gold sits in a handful of large custodian vaults.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin mreža je decentralizirana.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin mrežu kontrolira tisuće neovisnih čvorova. Većina fizičkog zlata pohranjena je u nekoliko velikih trezora.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, it's incredibly easy to verify that you have real Bitcoin by taking self-custody of your coins and running a full node.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can verify real Bitcoin by running a full node — it's just an app. Verifying physical gold requires melting it down; the inside could be tungsten.
entries.currentValue: S Bitcoinom je nevjerojatno lako provjeriti da imate pravi Bitcoin preuzimanjem samoskrbništva nad svojim kovanicama i pokretanjem punog čvora.
entries.targetTranslation: Svatko može provjeriti autentičnost Bitcoina pokretanjem punog čvora — to je samo aplikacija. Provjera fizičkog zlata zahtijeva njegovo topljenje; unutra može biti volfram.

entries.englishValueBefore: Just like there are 100 cents in 1 dollar, there are 100,000,000 sats in 1 Bitcoin. This enables Bitcoin to be used for all scales of purchases, including microtransactions as small as a few cents.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size purchase. Gold can't be easily divided for small transactions.
entries.currentValue: Baš kao što ima 100 centi u 1 dolaru, postoji 100.000.000 satsa u 1 Bitcoinu. To omogućuje korištenje Bitcoina za kupnje svih razmjera, uključujući mikrotransakcije male poput nekoliko centi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se može podijeliti na 100 milijuna satoshija i izvrstan je za kupnje bilo koje veličine. Zlato se ne može lako podijeliti za male transakcije.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be moved anywhere in the world instantly over the internet. Real estate is permanently fixed to a specific location and cannot be relocated, making it vulnerable to local economic conditions, natural disasters, and political instability.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves anywhere in the world instantly. Real estate is fixed to one location and exposed to local economic, political, and natural risks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se može premjestiti bilo kamo u svijetu trenutačno putem interneta. Nekretnine su trajno vezane za određenu lokaciju i ne mogu se premjestiti, što ih čini ranjivima na lokalne ekonomske uvjete, prirodne katastrofe i političku nestabilnost.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se kreće trenutačno globalno. Nekretnine su vezane za određenu lokaciju i izložene gospodarskim, političkim i okolišnim rizicima.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size. Real estate cannot be easily divided - you can't sell just the kitchen of your house or buy half a bedroom.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats. Real estate can't be partly sold — you can't offload just the kitchen or buy half a bedroom.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se može podijeliti na 100 milijuna manjih jedinica zvanih satoshi, čineći ga savršenim za transakcije bilo koje veličine. Nekretnine se ne mogu lako dijeliti - ne možete prodati samo kuhinju svoje kuće ili kupiti pola spavaće sobe.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se može podijeliti na 100 milijuna satoshija. Nekretnine se ne mogu prodati djelomično — ne možete prodati kuhinju ili kupiti pola spavaće sobe.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is subject to extensive government regulation including rent control, eviction moratoriums, zoning laws, and eminent domain where governments can seize your property.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is heavily regulated — zoning, rent control, eminent domain, and seizure all apply.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin djeluje na decentraliziranoj mreži koju nijedna vlada ne može kontrolirati. Nekretnine podliježu opsežnoj državnoj regulaciji uključujući kontrolu najamnina, moratorije na deložacije, zakonodavstvo o zoniranju i pravo izvlaštenja gdje vlade mogu oduzeti vašu imovinu.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin radi na decentraliziranoj mreži koju nijedna vlada ne može kontrolirati. Nekretnine su strogo regulirane — primjenjuju se zoniranje, kontrola najamnine, prinudno otkupljivanje i zapljena.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin requires no maintenance - it exists as digital code on a network. Real estate requires constant upkeep including repairs, renovations, property management, insurance, and dealing with tenants if rented.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin requires no upkeep. Real estate demands repairs, renovations, insurance, property management, and tenant issues.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ne zahtijeva održavanje - postoji kao digitalni kod na mreži. Nekretnine zahtijevaju stalno održavanje uključujući popravke, obnove, upravljanje imovinom, osiguranje i rad s podstanarima ako se iznajmljuje.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ne treba održavanje. Nekretnine zahtijevaju popravke, obnove, osiguranje, upravljanje nekretninom i rješavanje problema sa stanarima.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes - you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate is subject to annual property taxes that must be paid regardless of whether the property generates income, effectively forcing you to rent your own property from the government forever.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes — you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate owes annual property taxes regardless of income.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin nema tekuće poreze - plaćate porez na kapitalni dobitak samo kada prodajete. Nekretnine podliježu godišnjem porezu na imovinu koji se mora plaćati bez obzira na to generira li imovina prihod, učinkovito vas tjerajući da zauvijek iznajmljujete vlastitu imovinu od vlade.
entries.targetTranslation: Na Bitcoin nema povratnih poreza — porez na kapitalnu dobit plaća se samo pri prodaji. Nekretnine zahtijevaju godišnji porez na imovinu, bez obzira na prihod.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, or other natural disasters. Real estate is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and requires expensive insurance that may not fully cover losses.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives fire, flood, and earthquake. Real estate is vulnerable to every disaster, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin, kada je pravilno sigurnosno kopiran, ne može biti uništen poplavama, požarima, potresima, uraganima ili drugim prirodnim katastrofama. Nekretnine su ranjive na sve oblike fizičkog uništenja i zahtijevaju skupo osiguranje koje možda neće u potpunosti pokriti gubitke.
entries.targetTranslation: Dobro pohranjen Bitcoin preživljava požar, poplave i potrese. Nekretnine su ranjive na svaku katastrofu, a osiguranje rijetko sve pokriva.

entries.englishValueBefore: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Every piece of real estate is unique with different locations, conditions, and characteristics, making it difficult to price and compare properties.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every property is unique, making pricing and comparisons difficult.
entries.currentValue: Svaki bitcoin je identičan i zamjenjiv - jedan bitcoin jednak je jednom bitcoinu bilo gdje u svijetu. Svaka nekretnina je jedinstvena s različitim lokacijama, stanjem i karakteristikama, što otežava određivanje cijena i usporedbu imovine.
entries.targetTranslation: Svaki Bitcoin je jednak i zamjenjiv. Svaka nekretnina je jedinstvena, što otežava određivanje cijene i usporedbu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold 24/7 by anyone with internet access anywhere in the world. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers, require lengthy processes with lawyers and agents, and can take months to complete.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades globally 24/7 by anyone with internet access. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers and can take months of paperwork to close.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se može kupiti i prodati 24/7 od strane bilo koga s pristupom internetu bilo gdje u svijetu. Prodaja nekretnina ograničena je na lokalne kupce, zahtijeva dugotrajne procese s odvjetnicima i agentima, i može trajati mjesecima do završetka.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se prodaje 24/7 globalno svakoj osobi s internetskom vezom. Prodaja nekretnina ograničena je na lokalne kupce, a zatvaranje posla može trajati mjesecima.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership without intermediaries, promoting financial sovereignty for everyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence contributes to the financialization of housing, treating homes as commodities rather than shelter. This drives up prices, reduces affordability for families, and contributes to the housing and homelessness crisis affecting many countries today.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership for anyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence drives up housing prices, reducing affordability and fueling the housing crisis.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin omogućuje izravno individualno vlasništvo bez posrednika, promičući financijsku suverenost za sve. Kupovina nekretnina kao investicije izvan vašeg primarnog prebivališta doprinosi financijalizaciji stanovanja, tretirajući domove kao robu umjesto skloništa. To podiže cijene, smanjuje pristupačnost za obitelji i doprinosi stambenim i krizama beskućništva koje pogađaju mnoge zemlje danas.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin svakoj osobi daje izravno vlasništvo. Kupnja nekretnina kao investicija umjesto kao primarni dom podiže cijene stanovanja, smanjuje dostupnost i stvara stambenu krizu.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you own Bitcoin, you have direct ownership of the asset itself. When you own stocks, you own a share of a company, which means your investment depends on the company's performance, management decisions, and business success.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a direct asset you own outright. Stocks are shares in a company — their value depends on management, performance, and decisions you can't control.
entries.currentValue: Kada posjedujete Bitcoin, imate izravno vlasništvo nad samom imovinom. Kada posjedujete dionice, posjedujete udio u tvrtki, što znači da vaša investicija ovisi o uspješnosti tvrtke, odlukama uprave i poslovnom uspjehu.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je izravna imovina koju u potpunosti posjedujete. Dionica je dio tvrtke — njezina vrijednost ovisi o upravi, profitabilnosti i odlukama koje ne kontrolirate.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network with no single point of failure. Stock investments are subject to key person risk - if the CEO or other critical leaders leave, get sick, or make poor decisions, your investment can suffer significantly. Companies depend heavily on their leadership teams.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO and no single point of failure. Stocks depend heavily on leadership — one bad decision or departure can tank the price.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin djeluje na decentraliziranoj mreži bez jedne točke kvara. Ulaganja u dionice podložna su riziku ključne osobe - ako direktor ili drugi ključni voditelji odu, razbole se ili donesu loše odluke, vaša investicija može značajno patiti. Tvrtke uvelike ovise o svojim upravljačkim timovima.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin nema CEO-a ili jednu točku kvara. Dionice jako ovise o upravi — jedna pogrešna odluka ili odlazak ključne osobe može srušiti cijenu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's price is determined purely by market supply and demand. Stock prices are often evaluated using P/E ratios (Price-to-Earnings), which show how much investors pay for each dollar of company earnings. High P/E ratios can indicate overvalued stocks, making it harder to determine fair value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's price comes from open global markets. Stock valuations rely on metrics like P/E ratios that can mask overpriced shares.
entries.currentValue: Cijena Bitcoina određena je isključivo tržišnom ponudom i potražnjom. Cijene dionica često se procjenjuju pomoću P/E omjera (cijena-zarada), koji pokazuju koliko ulagači plaćaju za svaki dolar zarade tvrtke. Visoki P/E omjeri mogu ukazivati na precijenjene dionice, što otežava određivanje fer vrijednosti.
entries.targetTranslation: Cijena Bitcoina dolazi s globalnih otvorenih tržišta. Vrednovanje dionica oslanja se na pokazatelje poput P/E koji mogu prikriti precijenjene dionice.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on global exchanges.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 around the world. Stock markets are only open during business hours on weekdays.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se trguje 24 sata dnevno, 7 dana u tjednu na globalnim burzama.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se prodaje 24/7 globalno. Burze dionica otvorene su samo radnim danima i u određenim satima.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a fixed supply asset with a hard cap of 21 million Bitcoin that will ever exist. This makes it a great inflation hedge. Stocks have variable performance against inflation - some companies do well during inflationary periods while others struggle. There's no guarantee that any particular stock will protect against inflation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's fixed supply makes it a reliable inflation hedge. Some stocks beat inflation, others don't — there's no guarantee.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je imovina fiksne ponude sa strogim limitom od 21 milijun Bitcoina koji će ikada postojati. To ga čini sjajnom zaštitom od inflacije. Dionice imaju promjenjive performanse u odnosu na inflaciju - neke tvrtke dobro posluju tijekom inflacijskih razdoblja dok se druge bore. Nema jamstva da će bilo koja određena dionica zaštititi od inflacije.
entries.targetTranslation: Fiksna ponuda Bitcoina pouzdano štiti od inflacije. Neke dionice nadmaše inflaciju, druge ne — nema jamstva.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is an open network that anyone can join and use without permission. Credit card networks like Visa are closed systems controlled by financial institutions that can deny access to anyone they choose.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is an open network anyone can join and use without permission. Visa is a closed system controlled by financial institutions that can deny access — especially to the unbanked and underbanked.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je otvorena mreža kojoj se bilo tko može pridružiti i koristiti bez dozvole. Mreže kreditnih kartica poput Vise su zatvoreni sustavi kontrolirani od strane financijskih institucija koje mogu uskratiti pristup bilo kome.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je otvorena mreža kojoj se svatko može pridružiti bez dozvole. Visa je zatvoreni sustav koji kontroliraju financijske institucije koje mogu uskratiti pristup — posebno onima koji nemaju bankovni račun ili imaju ograničen pristup bankama.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a transparent blockchain where all transactions can be verified by anyone. Credit card networks operate as closed, proprietary systems where transaction details are hidden from public view.
entries.englishValue: Every Bitcoin transaction is on a public, auditable blockchain. Visa runs a closed, proprietary system where customers can't independently verify anything.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin djeluje na transparentnom blockchainu gdje sve transakcije može provjeriti bilo tko. Mreže kreditnih kartica djeluju kao zatvoreni, vlasnički sustavi u kojima su detalji transakcija skriveni od javnosti.
entries.targetTranslation: Svaka Bitcoin transakcija nalazi se na javnom blockchainu i može se provjeriti. Visa upravlja zatvorenim, ekskluzivnim sustavom koji klijenti ne mogu samostalno revidirati.

entries.englishValueBefore: Credit card companies can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time. Bitcoin cannot be frozen or controlled by any central authority.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can't be frozen by any central authority. Visa can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time.

entries.englishValueBefore: Accepting Bitcoin has many benefits like accepting payments with lower fees & getting more customers.
entries.englishValue: The simplest way to accept Bitcoin is with a hybrid wallet that automatically sells 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars (or your local currency) the instant a payment comes in.
entries.currentValue: Prihvaćanje Bitcoina ima mnoge prednosti poput prihvaćanja plaćanja s nižim naknadama i privlačenja više kupaca.
entries.targetTranslation: Najlakši način prihvaćanja Bitcoina je korištenje hibridnog novčanika: on automatski pretvara 100 % primljenog Bitcoina u dolare (ili vašu lokalnu valutu) čim plaćanje stigne.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use a Hybrid Wallet from our Wallet Guide and automatically sell 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars, you don't need to make any changes to your current accounting.
entries.englishValue: With this setup, your books look exactly like they do today — the final number is in dollars, every time. No cost basis, no capital gains, no new spreadsheets.
entries.currentValue: Ako koristite hibridni novčanik iz našeg vodiča za novčanike i automatski prodajete 100% primljenog Bitcoina za dolare, ne trebate mijenjati ništa u svom trenutnom računovodstvu.
entries.targetTranslation: S takvom postavkom vaše računovodstvo izgleda kao i danas — konačni iznos uvijek u dolarima. Bez troškovne osnovice, bez kapitalnih dobitaka, bez nove tablice.

entries.englishValueBefore: Tracking your cost basis is going to be the biggest difference between accounting for dollars and accounting for Bitcoin. Even if you view your business entirely in terms of Bitcoin, you need to report the dollar value of each transaction on your taxes.
entries.englishValue: Some businesses choose to keep a portion of the Bitcoin they receive instead of auto-converting it all. If that's you, the main extra step is tracking your cost basis — the dollar value of each Bitcoin payment on the day you received it.
entries.currentValue: Praćenje troškovne osnove bit će najveća razlika između računovodstva dolara i računovodstva Bitcoina. Čak i ako svoje poslovanje gledate isključivo u terminima Bitcoina, morate u poreznoj prijavi prijaviti dolarsku vrijednost svake transakcije.
entries.targetTranslation: Neka poduzeća odlučuju zadržati dio primljenog Bitcoina umjesto da sve automatski pretvore. Ako ste jedan od njih, dodatni je korak praćenje troškovne osnovice — vrijednosti svake Bitcoin uplate u dolarima na dan kad ste je primili.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use QuickBooks, you can do this automatically using the Bitcoin Sync plugin.
entries.englishValue: Even if you think of your business entirely in Bitcoin, most tax authorities still want the dollar value reported. The good news: it's just two numbers per transaction — the amount of Bitcoin received and its dollar value on that day.
entries.currentValue: Ako koristite QuickBooks, to možete učiniti automatski korištenjem dodatka Bitcoin Sync.
entries.targetTranslation: Čak i ako svoje poslovanje mjerite samo u Bitcoinu, većina poreznih tijela i dalje zahtijeva izvještavanje u dolarskoj vrijednosti. Dobra vijest: za svaku transakciju postoje samo dva broja — količina primljenog Bitcoina i njegova dolarska vrijednost na taj dan.

entries.englishValueBefore: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. This makes your money worth less over time.
entries.englishValue: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. That makes the money in your pocket worth less over time — and it's why prices keep going up year after year.
entries.currentValue: Inflacija nastaje kada se tiska ili stvara više novca iz ničega. To čini vaš novac manje vrijednim tijekom vremena.
entries.targetTranslation: Inflacija se događa kad se tiska više novca ili kad se stvara ni iz čega. To s vremenom smanjuje vrijednost novca u vašem džepu — zato cijene rastu iz godine u godinu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a fixed supply, which means no one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a fixed supply of 21 million coins. No government, bank, or company can print more of it. Your Bitcoin savings hold their value over time instead of quietly losing it.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ima fiksnu ponudu, što znači da nitko ne može tiskati više Bitcoina.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ima fiksnu ponudu: 21 milijun kovanica. Nijedna vlada, banka ili tvrtka ne može tiskati još. Vaša ušteđevina u Bitcoinu zadržava vrijednost s vremenom umjesto da je tiho gubi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Multiple US banks have collapsed in the past few years due to bank runs.
entries.englishValue: Multiple U.S. banks have collapsed in recent years because of bank runs. When too many customers tried to withdraw at once, the banks didn't have the cash to pay everyone back.
entries.currentValue: Više američkih banaka propalo je posljednjih godina zbog navala na banke.
entries.targetTranslation: Posljednjih su godina mnoge američke banke propale zbog bankovnih navala. Kad mnogi klijenti istodobno žele podići svoj novac, banke nemaju dovoljno gotovine za sve.

entries.englishValueBefore: Instead of just holding your money for you, banks invest and lend out your money. If those investments don't do well, they don't have enough to pay you back.
entries.englishValue: Instead of just holding your money, banks lend and invest most of it. If those investments go bad — or if depositors lose confidence — the bank can fail, and your deposits can be frozen or lost.
entries.currentValue: Umjesto da samo čuvaju vaš novac, banke ga ulažu i posuđuju. Ako te investicije ne idu dobro, nemaju dovoljno da vam vrate.
entries.targetTranslation: Osim što čuvaju vaš novac, banke veliki dio posuđuju i ulažu. Ako ta ulaganja propadnu — ili deponenti izgube povjerenje — banka može propasti, a vaši depoziti mogu biti zamrznuti ili izgubljeni.

entries.englishValueBefore: And the FDIC insurance fund only has $1 for every $100 they're insuring.
entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you can hold your own money directly in your own wallet. No bank. No intermediary. No bank run.
entries.currentValue: A osiguravajući fond FDIC ima samo 1 dolar na svakih 100 dolara koje osigurava.
entries.targetTranslation: S Bitcoinom svoj novac možete držati izravno u vlastitom novčaniku. Bez banke. Bez posrednika. Bez bankovnih navala.

entries.englishValueBefore: Unlike traditional financial networks, Bitcoin doesn't require permission to be used.
entries.englishValue: Unlike credit cards, PayPal, or traditional bank accounts, Bitcoin doesn't require anyone's permission to use.
entries.currentValue: Za razliku od tradicionalnih financijskih mreža, Bitcoin ne zahtijeva dozvolu za korištenje.
entries.targetTranslation: Za razliku od kreditnih kartica, PayPala ili tradicionalnih bankovnih računa, Bitcoinu ne treba ničije odobrenje.

entries.englishValueBefore: That means no one can stop you from using Bitcoin for any reason. It's the first financial network you can use without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.englishValue: No one can freeze your account, block a payment, or cut you off from the network. It's the first financial system in history you can use freely, without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.currentValue: To znači da vas nitko ne može spriječiti u korištenju Bitcoina iz bilo kojeg razloga. To je prva financijska mreža koju možete koristiti bez straha od cenzure ili oduzimanja.
entries.targetTranslation: Nitko ne može zamrznuti vaš račun, blokirati plaćanje ili vas isključiti iz mreže. To je prvi financijski sustav u povijesti koji možete koristiti bez straha od cenzure ili zapljene.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a misunderstood technology that is building a better world.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is often misunderstood, but it's quietly doing a lot of good in the world.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je pogrešno shvaćena tehnologija koja gradi bolji svijet.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se često pogrešno razumije, ali tiho čini puno dobrih stvari u svijetu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has enabled human rights activists to fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions, saved national parks, and so much more.

entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je omogućio aktivistima za ljudska prava da se bore za slobodu, smanjio globalne emisije metana, spasio nacionalne parkove i još mnogo toga.
entries.targetTranslation: Pomogao je aktivistima za ljudska prava da se bore za svoju slobodu, smanjio emisije metana s odlagališta i naftnih bušotina, stabilizirao električne mreže i financirao javne službe poput nacionalnih parkova.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have bank runs
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ne može imati bankovne navale

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a full-reserve system. You're not depositing your money in a bank. You are your own bank. There's no lending out your money without your knowledge because you are the only one who can access your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je sustav s punom rezervom. Svoj novac ne držite u banci. Vi ste sami sebi banka. Vaš novac ne posuđuje se nikome bez vašeg znanja; samo vi imate pristup.

entries.englishValue: As long as you hold bitcoin in your own wallet — not on an exchange or wrapped in an ETF — bank runs are impossible.
entries.targetTranslation: Sve dok držite svoj Bitcoin u vlastitom novčaniku — a ne na burzi ili u ETF-u — bankovna navala je nemoguća.

entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you're truly in control of your money.
entries.targetTranslation: S Bitcoinom imate stvarnu kontrolu nad svojim novcem.

entries.englishValue: Banks lend out your deposits under fractional reserve banking. If too many people withdraw at once, banks can fail. Bitcoin is a full-reserve system — bank runs are impossible.

entries.englishValue: Thousands of businesses couldn't pay their employees. The FDIC stepped in — but that raised a bigger question: is your money actually safe?

entries.englishValue: Banks don't hold your deposits in a vault. They lend your money out and invest it — that's called fractional reserve banking.
entries.targetTranslation: Banke ne čuvaju vaše depozite u trezoru. Posuđuju i ulažu vaš novac — to se zove bankarstvo s djelomičnom rezervom.

entries.englishValue: If too many people try to withdraw at the same time, the bank doesn't have enough cash to pay everyone. That's a bank run — and it can cause banks to collapse entirely.
entries.targetTranslation: Kad mnogi ljudi pokušaju istodobno podići svoj novac, banka nema dovoljno gotovine za sve. To je bankovna navala — i može dovesti do potpunog kolapsa banke.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin at your business doesn't have to complicate your accounting. Here's the short version — plus the tools and pros to make it painless.
entries.targetTranslation: Prihvaćanje Bitcoina u poslovanju ne mora komplicirati vaše računovodstvo. Evo kratkog pregleda — i alata i stručnjaka koji to čine jednostavnim.

entries.englishValue: If you already accept cash or card, adding Bitcoin to your business books is simpler than it looks. You have two paths: auto-convert every Bitcoin payment to dollars the moment it arrives (no new accounting needed), or keep some as Bitcoin (a few extra numbers to track).
entries.targetTranslation: Ako već primate gotovinu ili kartice, dodavanje Bitcoina u računovodstvo poduzeća jednostavnije je nego što mislite. Imate dvije mogućnosti: automatski pretvarati svaku Bitcoin uplatu u dolare čim stigne (bez novog računovodstva) ili zadržati nešto Bitcoina (morate pratiti nekoliko dodatnih brojeva).

entries.englishValue: This guide walks you through both — so you can pick the one that fits your business and start accepting Bitcoin with confidence.
entries.targetTranslation: Ovaj vodič objašnjava oba pristupa — kako biste mogli odabrati pravi za svoje poduzeće i sigurno početi prihvaćati Bitcoin.

entries.englishValue: The easy path: auto-convert to dollars
entries.targetTranslation: Lakši put: automatska pretvorba u dolare

entries.englishValue: That's it. The underlying math is identical to how any other appreciating or depreciating asset is accounted for.

entries.englishValue: Accept Bitcoin at your business for lower fees, instant settlement, no chargebacks, and more customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Prihvaćajte Bitcoin u svom poduzeću s manjim naknadama, trenutačnom namirom, bez povratnih uplata i s pristupom više kupaca.

entries.englishValue: Accept payments with lower fees, get paid instantly, and reach millions of new customers — with zero contracts and zero hidden costs.
entries.targetTranslation: Prihvaćajte plaćanja s manjim naknadama, namirite ih trenutačno i dosegnite milijune novih kupaca — bez ugovora i skrivenih troškova.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin gives your business a faster, cheaper, more private way to get paid. No middlemen. No chargebacks. No contracts. Just money that settles in seconds, directly from your customers to you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin vašem poduzeću daje brz, jeftin i privatan način primanja plaćanja. Bez posrednika. Bez povratnih uplata. Bez iznenadnih troškova. Novac u nekoliko sekundi, izravno od kupca do vas.

entries.englishValue: Work through these resources at your own pace. Each one is a short, practical guide.
entries.targetTranslation: Radite svojim tempom uz ove resurse. Svaki je kratak, praktičan vodič.

entries.englishValue: Tell us about your business

entries.englishValue: We only need a few details to get you listed. Address data is kept only long enough to submit your business to the maps.

entries.englishValue: List your business for free on BTC Map — the open, worldwide directory of Bitcoin-accepting merchants — so Bitcoiners nearby can find you and spend Bitcoin at your business.
entries.targetTranslation: Dodajte svoje poduzeće na BTC Map besplatno — otvoreni globalni katalog trgovaca koji prihvaćaju Bitcoin — kako bi vas lokalni Bitcoin korisnici mogli pronaći i potrošiti Bitcoin u vašem poduzeću.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoiners actively look for places to spend. Getting your business on the map puts you in front of every Bitcoin user searching for somewhere to eat, shop, or stay nearby — at zero cost to you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin korisnici aktivno traže mjesta gdje mogu potrošiti svoj novac. Pojavljivanje na karti stavlja vaše poduzeće pred svakog Bitcoin korisnika koji traži mjesto za jelo, kupnju ili boravak u blizini — potpuno besplatno.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin wallets are free. Pick one that fits your business — in-person, online, or invoice-based — and start accepting Bitcoin in minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin novčanici su besplatni. Odaberite najbolji za svoje poduzeće — uživo, online ili putem računa — i počnite prihvaćati Bitcoin u nekoliko minuta.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for invoice-based businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Novčanici za poduzeća koja kupcima šalju račune

entries.englishValue: If you invoice clients (consulting, freelancing, B2B services), use a wallet built around invoicing. Your client pays a Bitcoin invoice in a couple of clicks.
entries.targetTranslation: Ako svojim kupcima šaljete račune (savjetovanje, freelance, B2B usluge), koristite novčanik dizajniran za okruženje s računima. Kupac plaća Bitcoin račun u nekoliko klikova.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for businesses with multiple employees
entries.targetTranslation: Novčanici za poduzeća s više zaposlenika

entries.englishValue: If you have a team taking payments at the register, choose a wallet that supports multiple employee logins — so every employee gets their own PIN and you keep a clean audit trail of who took which payment.
entries.targetTranslation: Ako vaš tim prima plaćanja na blagajni, odaberite novčanik koji podržava prijave više zaposlenika — kako bi svaki zaposlenik imao svoj kod i mogli ste pratiti tko je primio koje plaćanje.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for online businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Novčanici za internetska poduzeća

entries.englishValue: Selling on a website? These wallets plug into your online store and accept Bitcoin from any customer, anywhere in the world — no chargebacks, no merchant account required.
entries.targetTranslation: Prodajete online? Ovi se novčanici povezuju s vašom internetskom trgovinom i prihvaćaju Bitcoin plaćanja od kupaca diljem svijeta — bez povratnih uplata i bez potrebe za trgovačkim računom.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for individually-owned businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Novčanici za samostalne trgovce

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Ako vodite trgovinu, kafić, studio ili uslugu sami, bilo koji od ovih novčanika prikladan je za vas. Odaberite hoćete li zadržati Bitcoin ili automatski pretvoriti dio svake uplate u lokalnu valutu.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Strike Business omogućuje vam prihvaćanje Bitcoin i Lightning plaćanja bez naknada i s trenutačnom namirom. Podržava plaćanja uživo, online i putem računa, s mogućnošću automatske pretvorbe u lokalnu valutu.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Niže naknade, više za poduzeće

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin plaćanja zaobilaze banke i kartične tvrtke koje uzimaju 2 – 3 % od svake prodaje. Poduzeće zadržava više od vašeg plaćanja — što često znači bolje cijene i bolju uslugu za vas.

entries.englishValue: Instant settlement, no chargebacks
entries.targetTranslation: Trenutačna namira, bez povratnih uplata

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin plaćanja se namiruju u nekoliko sekundi, izravno iz vašeg novčanika u poduzeće. Nema čekanja danima da banka oslobodi novac, niti skupih sporova oko povratnih uplata — što znači da se poduzeće može usredotočiti na pružanje usluge umjesto na borbu protiv prijevara.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Besplatno prihvaćanje, otvoreno svima

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Za prihvaćanje Bitcoina u poslovanju ne trebaju ugovori, mjesečni troškovi ni naknade za postavljanje. A milijuni Bitcoin korisnika diljem svijeta aktivno traže trgovce koji prihvaćaju Bitcoin — što besplatno predstavlja poduzeće novim kupcima.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin lets a business keep more of every sale, get paid instantly with no chargebacks, and reach a global audience of Bitcoin users — all with zero contracts and zero monthly fees.
entries.targetTranslation: Prihvaćanjem Bitcoina ovo poduzeće zadržava više od svake prodaje, prima trenutačna plaćanja bez povratnih uplata i dolazi do globalne publike Bitcoin korisnika — bez ugovora i mjesečnih troškova.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin nije dobar samo na blagajni — on je bolja vrsta novca koja štiti vašu ušteđevinu, privatnost i slobodu transakcija. Evo brzog sažetka.

entries.englishValue: You just scanned a Bitcoin Accepted Here sticker. Here's why that's great news — for this business, and for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Skenirali ste naljepnicu „Bitcoin Accepted Here“. Evo zašto je to dobra vijest — i za ovo poduzeće i za vas.

entries.englishValue: The business you're at accepts Bitcoin — a modern, open-source payment network that anyone can use, anywhere in the world, without banks or middlemen taking a cut.
entries.targetTranslation: Poduzeće u kojem ste prihvaća Bitcoin — moderan, otvoreni sustav plaćanja kojim svatko diljem svijeta može koristiti bez banaka i posrednika koji uzimaju svoj dio.

entries.englishValue: Each flyer includes a compelling headline and a QR code that sends curious readers to bitcoin.rocks to learn more.

entries.englishValue: Nostr clients are free apps that let you read and post on the Nostr network. All of them are interoperable — you can switch clients anytime and keep your followers and content.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr klijenti besplatne su aplikacije koje vam omogućuju čitanje i pisanje na Nostr mreži. Svi rade zajedno — možete u svakom trenutku promijeniti klijenta i zadržati svoje pratitelje i sadržaj.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new decentralized protocol for communicating online — no single company controls it, Bitcoin zaps are built in, and you can move between apps without losing your followers.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr je novi, decentralizirani komunikacijski protokol za internet — nije u vlasništvu nijedne tvrtke, ima ugrađene Bitcoin zapove i možete mijenjati aplikacije bez gubitka pratitelja.

entries.englishValue: What is Nostr?
entries.targetTranslation: Što je Nostr?

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr je poput e-pošte: nitko nije vlasnik protokola, svatko može graditi aplikacije na njemu i vi birate koja vam najbolje odgovara. Za razliku od Twittera ili Facebooka, ne postoji središnja tvrtka koja može cenzurirati, zatvoriti ili ušutkati vaše račune.

entries.englishValue: Protocol, not platform

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new protocol that lets you communicate online without fear of censorship, deplatforming, or deboosting.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr je novi protokol koji vam omogućuje komunikaciju na internetu bez straha od cenzure, zabrana ili ušutkavanja.

entries.englishValue: Platforms like Twitter and Facebook are controlled by a single company, but no one controls the Nostr protocol.
entries.targetTranslation: Platforme poput Twittera ili Facebooka kontrolira jedna tvrtka, ali Nostr protokol nitko ne kontrolira.

entries.englishValue: Freedom to move
entries.targetTranslation: Sloboda kretanja

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email. No one controls the email protocol, and anyone can build a client (like Gmail, Hotmail, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr je poput e-pošte. Nitko ne kontrolira protokol e-pošte i svatko može izgraditi klijenta (poput Gmaila, Hotmaila itd.).

entries.englishValue: No one controls the Nostr protocol either, and anyone can build a client (like Damus, Amethyst, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Ni Nostr protokol nitko ne kontrolira i svatko može izgraditi klijenta (poput Damusa, Amethysta itd.).

entries.englishValue: If you don't like how a certain client works, you can seamlessly move your Nostr account to another client without losing your followers or content.
entries.targetTranslation: Ako vam se ne sviđa kako neki klijent radi, možete prebaciti svoj Nostr račun u drugog klijenta bez gubitka pratitelja ili sadržaja.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in
entries.targetTranslation: Ugrađen Bitcoin

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in natively to the Nostr protocol. If you see content you like, you can easily zap Bitcoin to someone as a thank you!
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je ugrađen u Nostr protokol. Kad vidite sadržaj koji vam se sviđa, možete poslati „Bitcoin zap“ kako biste zahvalili autoru.

entries.englishValue: On centralized platforms like Twitter and Facebook, the centralized company earns money from your content. But on open protocols like Nostr, you earn money from your content.
entries.targetTranslation: Na centraliziranim platformama poput Twittera i Facebooka, središnja tvrtka zarađuje na vašem sadržaju. Ali na otvorenom protokolu poput Nostra, vi zarađujete na svom sadržaju.
